title: CA18515 - RFQ 2026/38 - NMANDD PEACEPLUS "Thriving Together" - Shared History & Culture Program - Hanna's Close
description: Competent consultancy companies are hereby invited to tender to design, develop and deliver a shared history and culture programme that will increase participants' knowledge and understanding of individual, family and collective history through the exploration of Hanna's Close, a preserved Ulster-Scots clachan (settlement) in Aughnahoory, Kilkeel. The programme will place a particular emphasis on genealogy; tracing family connections linked to Hanna's Close and examining patterns of emigration from the settlement. Participants will explore how generations of local families established new lives across the world and consider the social, economic and cultural impact these individuals and their descendants have had on communities both locally and internationally. title: Linstone Housing Landscape Maintenance Contract 2026-2029
description: The Contract will principally comprise litter picking, grass cutting, shrub bed & hedging, ad-hoc moss clearance of hard standing areas maintenance and leaf collection landscape maintenance services to existing properties and common landscaped areas throughout Renfrewshire to the areas detailed within the Landscape Architects MAP’s. The Contract may also include tree maintenance services, tree and stump removal works, and repairs to existing damaged grass areas. The Contract, as tendered, only includes properties and landscaped areas throughout Linwood, Johnstone and Paisley. However, Linstone Housing also provide services to their customers in Bridge of Weir, Renfrew, Elderslie and Kilbarchan, and additional properties or landscaped areas throughout Renfrewshire may be introduced by Linstone Housing during the Contract. Shrubs bed maintenance will mainly be undertaken by the Estates Management Team of Linstone Housing rather than the Contractor. However, the Contractor will be required to undertake shrub bed maintenance to the following estates/MAP’s, the areas of which have been incorporated within the tender pricing document; 1. M02 Rev B Dykebar – areas S11 and S12 to be maintained by the Contractor. Bidders are advised that areas S11 and S12 are actually hedging and have been incorrectly recorded as shrub bed areas on MAP M02 2. M10 Rev B Sandyflats – areas S1 and S2 to be maintained by the Contractor; 3. M19 Rev B Town Centre – all shrub beds to be maintained by the Contractor; and 4. M20 Rev B Abernethy Drive – all shrub beds to be maintained by the Contractor. Bidders are also advised that Linstone Housing do not anticipate the Contractor having to undertake any works during the contract at the following estates/MAPS’s; a. M01 Bridge of Weir; b. M04 Glen Street Paisley; c. M06 Johnstone Castle; d. M07 Rev A Kilbarchan; e. M08 Renfrew Rd or Kirklandneuk; f. M09 Corseford; g. M21 Brown Street; and h. M22 Ellerslie Street. Bidders are further advised that the grass area G1 detailed on MAP M10 Rev B Sandyflats is rough grass and will receive only one rough grass cut per annum. The Estates Management Team of Linstone Housing will also generally undertake moss clearance of hard standing areas with the exception of the hard standing areas detailed on M02 Rev B Dykebar. The Contractor will be required to undertake moss clearance three times annually (April, June and October) to the hard standing areas detailed on M02 Rev B Dykebar.

title: Notice of Intent to Sole Source-AAMC Ancillary Services
description: The U.S. Army Mission and Installation Contracting Command (MICC) - Fort Knox, 199 6th Avenue, Suite 250, Fort Knox, KY, 40121, intends to award a sole-source, firm-fixed-price contract to The Expo Group, LLC, (UEI: C4GLL794MPH9 | CAGE Code: 03KR0) 5931 Campus Circle Drive, West Irving, TX 75063-2606. The procurement is for convention ancillary services including carpeting, carpet padding, labor, accessories, electrical services and material handling services at the Association of American Medical Colleges (AAMC) Lead, Learn, Serve 2026: The AAMC Annual Meeting being held at the Anaheim Convention Center, 800 W Katella Ave, Anaheim, CA 92802 from 06-09 November 2026. This action is being conducted under FAR Part 12 (DFARS CD 2026-O00028), Acquisition of Commercial Products and Commercial Services The statutory authority permitting other than full and open competition is simplified acquisition procedures for commercial products and commercial services, Title 41 U.S.C. 1901, as implemented by FAR 12.102(a) (DFARS CD 2026-O0028), Only one source is available valued at or below the simplified acquisition threshold. This is not a request for competitive offers, quotes, or capability statements. No solicitation will be posted as a result of this notice. This notice complies with FAR 5.101 (DFARS CD 2026-O0003), Presolicitation notice. However, interested parties may submit capability statements demonstrating their ability to meet this requirement within the required timeframe. description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION FOR COMMERCIAL ITEMS This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR) subpart 12.6, "Streamlined Procedures for Evaluation and Solicitation for Commercial Items," as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. The following factors shall be used to evaluate offers: Lowest Price Technically Acceptable - Offers will be ranked lowest to highest according to price. A price analysis will be conducted to determine whether the lowest price will result from a single award or multiple awards. Based on the price analysis, the lowest price offer or multiple offers, will be forwarded to the requiring activity for technical evaluation (offer(s), in accordance with the specifications, will be deemed either technically acceptable or technically unacceptable). If the lowest price offer is determined technically unacceptable, another analysis will be conducted amongst the remaining offers to determine if a single or multiple awards will provide the lowest price. The lowest price offer(s) will be sent for technical evaluation. This process is repeated in order of price until an offer or combination of offers is deemed technically acceptable and price is determined fair and reasonable. Options. When applicable, the Government will evaluate offers for award purposes by adding the total price for all options to the total price for the basic requirement. description: 5P468-26-0151/A Stage 2 -Amishku-Shipiss-Kigiap Konga - Beaver Brook Camp-Akami-Uapishk?-KakKasuak-Mealy Mountains National Park Reserve REQUIREMENT The Beaver Brook Camp project involves the complete construction of a camp facility located at the junction of Lake Melville and Etagaulet River, in Newfoundland and Labrador (Approx. coordinates are: 53°42'56.37"N 59°01'06.20"W). The Camp is comprised of 3 buildings, a Lodge (69m2 with a 34m2 screen porch and deck), a Privy (Backcountry Toilet, approx. 18m2) and a Cache (Storage Shed, approx. 25m2), all linked through wooden boardwalks (approx. 250m of boardwalks) and powered through solar panels. Tent Pads (five (5) total), a food cache, a seasonal floating dock, log benches, picnic tables, fire pit and a traditional camping site are also included in this project. Overall site work, tree clearing, topsoil preservation and re-naturalization, is required for this site. The site is remote with no existing infrastructure and is only accessible by boat, seaplane, helicopter or by snowmobile (during winter-pending safe ice conditions). TWO STAGE SELECTION PROCESS This posting is the Stage Two of a two-stage solicitation process: the first stage was to evaluate the qualifications of all interested suppliers. The second stage (Stage Two) is to invite the qualified suppliers to provide further qualifications and a financial bid on the project based on the specifications and drawings. Only qualified suppliers have been invited to bid. Potential and interested sub-contractors are invited to add their company’s name under the section “Partner with another business”

title: Cabot Tower Signal Mast Replacement, Signal Hill National Historic Site
description: 5P468-26-0234/A Cabot Tower Signal Mast Replacement, Signal Hill National Historic Site BIDS RECEIVED BY FAX AND EMAIL WILL BE ACCEPTED AS OFFICIAL. PARKS CANADA IS NOT CURRENTLY ACCEPTING BIDS VIA SAP ARIBA, YOU MUST SUBMIT YOUR BID VIA FAX OR EMAIL AS INDICATED IN THE SOLICITATION DOCUMENT. BIDS RECEIVED IN-PERSON OR BY COURIER WILL NOT BE ACCEPTED. The only acceptable email address for responses to the bid solicitation is soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca. Bids submitted by email directly to the Contracting Authority or to any email address other than soumissionsami-bidsrpc@pc.gc.ca will not be accepted. The only acceptable facsimile for responses to bid solicitations is 1-855-983-1808. The maximum email file size that Parks Canada is capable of receiving is 15 megabytes. The Bidder is responsible for any failure attributable to the transmission or receipt of the emailed bid due to file size. The Bidder should be cognisant of the size of the email as a whole, and not only the attachments. Please take into consideration that some attachments, when sent, may be resized during the email transfer. If the email size is too large, the Bidder should send the bid in multiple emails properly labeled with the solicitation number, project name, and indicate how many emails are included (ex. 1 of 2). Emails with links to bid documents will not be accepted. Bid documents must be sent as email attachments. REQUIREMENT Parks Canada requires the removal of the existing signal mast, and the supply and install of a new signal mast atop of Cabot Tower. CONTRACTOR SELECTION AND INDIGENOUS PARTICIPATION PLAN The Contractor should ensure provision of specific and agreed upon benefits for Indigenous People and Indigenous Businesses in the Area of the Contract. This Invitation to Tender contains bid criteria in order to provide socioeconomic benefits to Indigenous communities within the area covered by the contract. PERIOD OF CONTRACT / DELIVERY DATE Contractor must perform and complete the Work no later than March 31, 2027. OPTIONAL SITE VISIT It is recommended that the Bidder or a representative of the Bidder visit the work site. Arrangements have been made for the site visit to be held at at the entrance door for Cabot Tower, located at 230 Signal Hill Rd, St. John's, NL A1C 5M on October 14, 2026. The site visit will begin at 10:30am NDT. Bidders must communicate with the Contracting Authority no later than October 12 at 12:00pm NDT to confirm attendance and provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend. Bidders must also complete and submit a certification. Bidders who do not confirm attendance, provide the name(s) of the person(s) who will attend, or who do not complete and submit the above certification as required will not be allowed access to the site. Bidders will be requested to sign an attendance sheet. No alternative appointment will be given to bidders who do not attend or do not send a representative. Bidders who do not participate in the visit will not be precluded from submitting a bid. Any clarifications or changes to the bid solicitation resulting from the site visit will be included as an amendment to the bid solicitation. ENQUIRIES All enquiries of a technical and contractual nature are to be submitted to the Contracting Authority. Enquiries regarding this solicitation must be submitted in writing and should be received no later than five (5) calendar days prior to the date set for solicitation closing to allow sufficient time to provide a response. Enquiries received after that time may result in an answer NOT being provided. INFORMATION National Parks Regulations require that all work is to be performed in accordance with the ordinances, laws, rules and regulations set out in the National Park Act. Bidders that consider themselves qualified to provide this Work and intend to submit bids on this project should obtain documents from the Government Electronic Tendering Service through the Government of Canada tendering service at http://canadabuys.canada.ca/en/tender-opportunities. Addenda, when issued, will be available from the Government of Canada tendering service. Bidders that elect to base their bids on documents obtained from other sources do so at their own risk. Late submissions will not be considered. The Crown retains the right to negotiate with suppliers on any procurement. Documents may be submitted in either official language of Canada. Parks Canada has made every effort to provide equivalent documents in both official languages, however, if you find any discrepancies between the English and French documents, please notify the contract officer listed in this opportunity as soon as possible so that we can rectify the situation.

title: Realizace optimalizace distribučních sazeb NN u odběrných míst MŽP

Součástí předmětu plnění je: • provedení administrace změn distribučních sazeb u jednotlivých odběrných míst, • jednání a zajištění součinnosti s příslušnými provozovateli distribučních soustav a dalšími dotčenými subjekty, • zpracování, kompletace a podání žádostí o změnu distribučních sazeb, • zajištění veškerých technických, provozních a administrativních podkladů nezbytných pro schválení změny distribuční sazby, • dodávka a montáž nezbytných elektroinstalačních prvků a komponent, • provedení úpravy elektroměrových rozvaděčů a souvisejících elektrických zařízení v rozsahu nezbytném pro přiznání dvoutarifní distribuční sazby, • zajištění a provedení výchozích, popř. následných revizí podle platných právních a technických předpisů, • zpracování a předání revizních zpráv a dalších dokladů požadovaných provozovatelem distribuční soustavy, • zajištění dokončení procesu změny distribuční sazby u jednotlivých odběrných míst včetně odstranění případných nedostatků zajištěných v průběhu schvalovacího procesu, • předání kompletní dokumentace vztahující se k realizovaným změnám zadavateli.

title: Anskaffelse av løsning for backup og reservedrift
description: Plan- og bygningsetaten forvalter store mengder data knyttet til byggesaker, eiendom, geodata og mer. Stabil tilgang til disse dataene er avgjørende for å sikre effektiv saksbehandling og leveranse av tjenester til innbyggere og næringsliv. Anskaffelsens formål er å etablere en sikker og robust løsning for sikkerhetskopiering og gjenoppretting av data. Løsningen som anskaffes skal bidra til å sikre høy tilgjengelighet til etatens data og systemer og redusere risiko knyttet til tap av data, sikkerhetshendelser og driftsavbrudd. Løsningen skal understøtte etatens behov for: - beskyttelse av virksomhetskritiske data - rask gjenoppretting ved hendelser - robusthet mot cybertrusler (herunder ransomware) - fleksibilitet i forbindelse med overgang til Oslo kommunes felles IKT-plattform Anskaffelsen omfatter en samlet løsning for backup og gjenoppretting som kan bestå av: - tjenesteleveranse fra leverandørens plattform - drift av løsninger i kundens eller tredjeparts miljø - nødvendige komponenter for lagring og gjenoppretting Løsningen skal sikre at sikkerhetskopier lagres på minst to uavhengige lokasjoner, som er fysisk og logisk adskilt.

title: Anskaffelse av konsulenttjenester for støtte til videreutvikling av en produktorientert og smidig organisasjon
description: Anskaffelsens formål er å inngå en kontrakt om kjøp av konsulenttjeneste som kan bidra i vårt arbeid med å styrke Mattilsynets evne til å arbeide smidig, tverrfaglig og verdiorientert i hele organisasjonen. Formålet er å bidra til at virksomheten: styrker sin smidige modenhet etablerer og videreutvikler effektive myndiggjorte team forbedrer flyt fra behov til levert verdi styrker kontinuerlig læring og forbedring utvikler ledere og medarbeidere i smidig ledelse og arbeidsform reduserer unødvendige avhengigheter, flaskehalser og koordinering får bedre sammenheng mellom virksomhetens mål, prioriteringer og teamenes arbeid bygger intern kompetanse slik at virksomheten i størst mulig grad blir selvhjulpen over tid. Et sentralt mål med oppdraget er læring og kompetansebygging i organisasjonen gjennom aktiv kunnskaps- og erfaringsoverføring fra konsulenten til våre ansatte. Konsulenten skal primært bidra til varig kompetansebygging og utvikling av virksomhetens arbeidsformer. Oppdraget skal derfor ikke begrenses til å introdusere eller følge opp enkeltstående smidige metoder eller rammeverk. Vi søker en konsulent som evner å se sammenhengen mellom mennesker, team, ledelse, organisering, styring og verdiskaping i et smidig perspektiv.

title: Finland – Wide area network services – Tietoliikennepalvelut ja valokuituverkon myynti
description: Hankintayksikkö pyytää tarjousta seuraavasta palvelukokonaisuudesta: • Tietoliikenneverkko sekä tähän liittyviä optioita. Toimittajan tulee tarjota kokonaisuutta. Osatarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Vaihtoehtoisia tarjouksia ei hyväksytä. Kyseisen kokonaisuuden tarkemmat tiedot ja tarjousvaatimukset löytyvät tarjouspyynnön liitteestä 1, jossa on ilmoitettu tarjottavien palveluiden vähimmäis- ja laatuvaatimukset. Osana hankintaa myydään Tilaajan omistaman kuituverkon yhteyksiä Toimittajalle. Toimittaja ilmoittaa hintaliitteellä hinnan, jonka se kuituverkosta maksaa Tilaajalle. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska kyseessä on tekninen ja toiminnallinen kokonaisuus, jonka jakaminen osiin muodostaisi Tilaajalle merkittävän teknisen ja toiminnallisen riskin sekä saattaisi merkittävästi haitata kriittisten tietoliikenneyhteyksien saatavuutta tulevaisuudessa. Hankinnassa noudatetaan hankintalakia (1397/2016). Menettelytapana on EU kynnysarvon ylittävä avoin menettely. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjat ovat suomen kielellä ja tarjous tulee antaa suomen kielellä. Tarjoajan tulee huomioida, että hankinta-asiakirjojen saantia on rajoitettu hankintalain 69.3 §:n perusteella: Kaikkia hankinta-asiakirjoja ei voida asettaa rajoituksetta, suoraan ja kokonaan sähköisessä muodossa saataville tietojen luottamuksellisuuden suojaamiseksi. Tarjouspyyntöasiakirjoihin liittyy salassa pidettävää aineistoa (Tarjouspyynnön liite 4 - Kohdeluettelo). Menettelyohjeet salassapidettävän materiaalin saamiseksi on ilmoitettu hankintailmoituksen kohdassa: "Hankintaa tai osaa koskevat lisätiedot". Learnpoint ICT Oy toimii hankinnassa konsulttina.

title: Romania – Programming services of application software – Servicii soluție informatică integrată în cadrul Proiectului ”Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping"
description: Achizitia serviciilor de dezvoltare si implementare a Platformei de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agentia Nationala Anti-Doping, precum si a produselor hardware, a licentelor software si a solutiilor de securitate cibernetica necesare functionarii acesteia, in cadrul proiectului cod SMIS 342867. Prin prestarea serviciilor solicitate, autoritatea contractanta urmareste digitalizarea serviciilor publice furnizate de ANAD la un grad de sofisticare 4, care sa asigure o interactiune digitala avansata intre ANAD si beneficiarii serviciilor publice furnizate de aceasta. Autoritatea contractanta va raspunde in mod clar si complet tuturor solicitarilor de clarificare/informatiilor suplimentare in a 11-a zi inainte de termenul limita stabilit pentru depunerea ofertelor. Numarul de zile pana la care se pot solicita clarificari inainte de data limita de depunere a ofertelor: 20 zile. ANAD dorește să achiziționeze servicii soluție informatică integrată (pachet complet pentru implementarea soluției informatice de digitalizare a serviciilor publice ANAD , hardware, licente, servicii dezvoltare, Securitate cibernetică, instruire).Achiziția este planificată în cadrul proiectului „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”, Cod SMIS 342867, finanțat prin Programul Creștere Inteligentă, Digitalizare și Instrumente Financiare 2021–2027 (PoCIDIF). În contextul accelerării transformării digitale la nivel european și național, precum și al creșterii cerințelor de eficiență operațională, ANAD inițiază un proiect amplu de digitalizare a serviciilor publice oferite, intitulat „Platforma de Servicii Publice Digitale pentru Agenția Națională Anti-Doping”. Necesitatea proiectului este determinată de limitele infrastructurii informatice actuale și de absența unui cadru digital integrat pentru interacțiunea cu beneficiarii serviciilor anti-doping. Prin realizarea acestui proiect, ANAD își propune să devină un model de bune practici în administrarea publică, oferind servicii eficiente și moderne care să răspundă nevoilor actuale și viitoare ale funcționarilor publici și cetățenilor. Modernizarea sistemului informatic va permite o gestionare internă mai eficientă, va facilita accesul la servicii digitale și va asigura un nivel înalt de securitate și conformitate.

title: Floating Dock Approach Reconstruction, Chance Cove NL
description: Work under this project includes, but is not limited to, the provision of all plant, labour, equipment material and supervision required to complete reconstruction at Chance Cove, NL. In general, work under this contract will consist of, but will not necessarily be limited to the following: • Demolition and removal of the existing floating dock support crib, fencing, walking bridge and marginal wharf. • Construction of new floating dock approach cribbing. • Supply and installation of a new gangway. • Uplands work, as noted on the drawings, including granulars and rip rap.

title: Material Disposal - Codroy NL
description: The work consists of the furnishing of all plant, labour, equipment and material for material disposal at Codroy, NL. In general, work under this contract will consist of, but will not necessarily be limited to, the following: 1. Removal of previously excavated/dredged material, which is currently stockpiled at the SCH main site in Codroy, NL. The disposal location for the soil is the DFO breakwater site northwest of the main facility. Note that the existing stockpile contains remnants of a plastic/enviroliner in amongst the soil. There may also be some wood and other debris in amongst the stockpile, from the previous dredging operations. In all cases, the plastics, wood, etc., are to be removed prior to disposing of the soil at the disposal site. Plastics/wood/etc., removed from the stockpile is to be transported off site and disposed of at a Provincially approved waste disposal facility. 2. Supply and installation of Class “B” and Class “A” granulars. 3. Supply and installation of 300mm diameter rock fill capping material to cover the soil at the disposal site. 4. Supply and installation of stone barricades at the approach to the disposal area.

title: RF Data Fusion for Command and Control
description: This Challenge notice is issued under the Innovation for Defence Excellence and Security (IDEaS) Program Call for Proposals (CFP) Call 006 (W7714-248676/A). Solicitation Documents reference: See bidding details section. *For additional general information on the IDEaS Program, visit: https://www.canada.ca/en/department-national-defence/programs/defence-ideas.html _____________ This challenge is open to receive proposals for Component 1a, Component 1b and Component 2. Proposed solutions that fall within technology readiness levels (TRL) 1-9 can be submitted to this challenge. Steps to apply: Step 1: read this challenge Step 2: read the Call for Proposals : See bidding details section Step 3: propose your solution here : https://defence-innovation-portal.my.site.com/ _____________ Maximum Funding and Performance Period Multiple contracts could result from this Challenge. The individual maximum contract funding available under Component 1a (TRL 1-3) is up to $250,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of up to 6 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 1b (TRL 4-5) is up to $1,500,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes) for a maximum performance period of 12 months. The maximum individual contract funding available under Component 2 (TRL 6-9) is up to $5,000,000 CAD (excluding applicable taxes). The period of performance will be determined at the time of contract negotiation. The maximum individual contractual funding and the maximum performance period offered under Component 3 will be determined by Canada at the time of contract negotiation. This disclosure is made in good faith and does not commit Canada to contract for the total approximate funding. _____________ Challenge Details Challenge Title: W7714-248676/017 - RF Data Fusion for Command and Control The Department of National Defence (DND) and the Canadian Armed Forces (CAF) are seeking innovative software-based solutions to seamlessly convert, analyze, and fuse real-time, domain-specific, content-rich data transmitted over radio frequency (RF) bearers into a secure, standardized pan-domain Command and Control (C2) format to enhance interoperability and enable timely, data-driven decision-making across all domains and levels of command. Background and context Radio frequency (RF) communications in military operations are inherently bandwidth-constrained and vulnerable to jamming, interference, and environmental effects, making them unreliable in contested environments. To maintain timely and effective support across all warfighting domains, data transmitted over RF bearers should be transformed into compact, structured messages, such as eXtensible Markup Language (XML)-based Message Text Formats (MTF) or other machine-readable schemas. Such messages should be optimized for transmission over tactical networks including Low Frequency (LF), Very Low Frequency (VLF), High Frequency (HF), Ultra High Frequency (UHF), and Satellite Communications (SATCOM). This approach enables resilient, standards-based communication across domains (land, air, maritime, cyber, and space) and functional services (e.g., Joint Intelligence Surveillance and Reconnaissance (JISR), medical, logistics), in line with doctrinal requirements for pan-domain operations. CAF tactical messaging remains largely dependent on legacy systems. These systems are inflexible, poorly suited to machine-to-machine exchange, and increasingly misaligned with NATO’s shift toward XML-based, data-centric frameworks. CAF operators currently lack integrated, machine-readable messaging systems. As a result, they must manually convert voice, chat, and text inputs into formal military products including orders, situation reports, and Requests for Information (RFIs) to comply with command structures and coalition standards. Modern, pan-domain operations require that doctrinal and technical Information Exchange Requirements (IERs) be met at the speed of operational relevance, with messaging that is interoperable, standardized, and capable of supporting real-time, data-driven decision-making in joint and coalition environments. As NATO, the U.S. Department of Defense, and other Five Eyes partners adopt XML-based, machine-readable messaging frameworks, the CAF is prioritizing alignment with these emerging data models to improve interoperability, operational agility, and mission effectiveness. The DND/CAF are seeking innovative, interoperable, and scalable solutions that will contribute to the development of a next-generation digital military RF messaging and data exchange. Innovators are invited to propose technologies, platforms, or integrated systems. Essential Outcomes The proposed solution must: • Be a software-based capability (e.g., standalone application, plug-in, middleware, or service). • Support DND/CAF operations across all domains (land, air, maritime, space, cyber) and functional services (e.g., C2, intelligence, logistics). • Implement structured, standards-compliant messaging (e.g., MTF-XML) and data exchange protocols (e.g., National Information Exchange Model (NIEM), NATO Core Data Framework (NCDF)), with documented interfaces for importing, exporting, and exchanging data using those standards. • Be configurable and modular, supporting Character-Oriented Information Exchange (COIE) processing and designed for future extensibility (e.g., to accommodate emerging or disruptive standards). • Provide documented interfaces and standards-based data exchange mechanisms to support system integration, including use within experimentation, simulation, and wargaming environments. Desired Outcomes The proposed solution should include capabilities such as, but not limited to, the following: • Operability in Denied, Degraded, Intermittent, and Low Bandwidth (DDIL) environments, with scalability to support evolving mission requirements and force structures. • Enhanced user experience features such as intuitive interfaces, multilingual support, automation of routine workflows, and built-in decision aids. • Standardized, documented integration interfaces (e.g., application programming interfaces (APIs)) to enable integration with at least one Service Management or Service Monitoring tools or platforms (e.g., ServiceNow, Splunk, Dynatrace, Microsoft System Center, Azure Monitor, etc.). • Readiness for future integration of Artificial Intelligence (AI)/Machine Learning (ML) capabilities to support data fusion, intelligent message prioritization, and real-time decision support.

title: SPECTRORADIOMETERS
description: This notice is published on buyandsell for a period of 15 Calendar Days The Department of National Defence requires the following items: Quantity 2 spectroradiometers with additional accessories and software. Requirement: to replace obsolete spectroradiometers (PR-1980A and PR-715) with two new spectroradiometer units. The spectroradiometer is a spectral based photometric and colorimetric light measurement instrument used for applications requiring precise light measurements from a range of light sources, such as display monitors and projectors, reflective surfaces, and industrial/military applications (e.g. visual display testing, LED testing, film and video post-production, vehicle/aerospace displays, and instrument color testing). Requested delivery date for all of the above mentioned is March 15th 2027 Goods must be consigned and delivered to QETE Supply Warehouse, NPB Building, 45 Blvd Sacré Coeur, Room C1113, Ramp 7, Gatineau, QC, J8X 1C6.

title: RFI - WildFireSat Global
description: ***This Amendment is raised to extend the RFI end date to Thursday October 29, 2026 at 2:00PM (EDT)*** Please note that late submissions will not be considered or accepted. Ensure you are fully registered in CanadaBuys/SAP Ariba! Public Services and Procurement Canada (PSPC), on behalf of the Canadian Space Agency (CSA), is issuing this Request for Information (RFI) to solicit input from industry in support of the planning, definition, and implementation phases (i.e. Phases B, C and D)of the WildFireSat - Global (WFS). The WildFireSat - Global expands the original Canada-focused WildFireSat mission to a global scope for monitoring wildfire activity across 100% of the Earth’s vegetated land surface, while evaluating additional potential areas of interest, including Arctic and coastal regions. Canada will hold a virtual Industry Information Session on Tuesday June 2, 2026 at 11:00AM (EDT).

title: EP076-270289 Sir Frederick Banting Building Fire Alarm System Improvements
description: This project involves replacing the existing fire alarm system at the Sir Frederick Banting Building with a new fully addressable, networked fire alarm system while maintaining continuous building operations and fire protection throughout construction. The work includes installing new fire alarm equipment, devices, wiring, and controls; integrating the system with elevators, HVAC equipment, electromagnetic locks, fire protection systems, emergency generators, and the monitoring station; and completing all required testing, verification, commissioning, and code compliance activities. Once the new system is operational and accepted, the existing fire alarm infrastructure will be removed and all affected areas restored. The work will be carried out in phases within an occupied laboratory and office facility, requiring careful coordination to minimize disruptions and maintain life-safety functions at all times.

Hankinnan kohteena oleva palvelu sisältää Espoon kaupungin sekä sen konserniyhtiöiden (Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö, Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat, Espoon Asunnot Oy, Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli, Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus, Weegee Oy ja Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio) omistamien tai hallinnoimien rakennusten, tilojen ja toimipisteiden keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin sekä SER-jätteen poistopalvelut. Rakennukset sijaitsevat Espoon kaupungin alueella. Tilaajalla on myös muita sopimuksia, joita käytetään kuljetusominaisuuksiltaan vaaralliseksi jätteeksi luokiteltuun SER-jätteeseen sekä muun tietoturvamateriaalin poistopalvelussa. Suurin osa mm. perustietotekniikasta poistetaan tämän sopimuksen kautta. Tarjoaja voi toteuttaa osan palvelusta alihankintana. Tietoturvamateriaalin käsittelyä ja siihen liittyviä palveluita ei saa toteuttaa alihankintana, henkilöstövuokrauksella eikä muiden yksiköiden tai voimavarayksiköiden henkilöstöä käyttämällä. Palvelu tulee tuottaa kokonaisuudessaan tarjoajan omalla henkilöstöllä ja omana toimintana. Tarkempi kuvaus hankinnan sisällöstä on tarjouspyynnön liitteellä "Hankinnan kohteen kuvaus". Sopimus solmitaan yhden (1) Toimittajan kanssa. Lisäksi valitaan yksi (1) varatoimittaja. Sopimus on toistaiseksi voimassaoleva. Hankinnan ennakoitu kokonaisarvo on 717 000 (alv. 0 %). Eurot jakaantuvat hankintayksiköiden välillä seuraavasti: Espoon kaupunki 150 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Sotekiinteistöt 20 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Keskuskeittiö 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Espoon Koulu- ja päiväkotitilat 50 000€ Espoon Asunnot Oy 447 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän uimahalli 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Opinmäen Kampus 10 000€ Weegee Oy 10 000€ Kiinteistö Oy Matinkylän Lukio 10 000€ Hankinnan valmistelu Hankintayksikkö on valmistellut hankintaa arvioimalla markkinoilla olevia vaihtoehtoja ja kilpailuolosuhteita sekä hankinnan toteuttamistapoja. Markkinakartoituksessa on kuultu alan toimijoita kirjallisesti, arvioitu hankinnan jakamista osiin sekä eri toteutusmalleja. Markkinakartoitus on toteutettu siten, ettei yksittäistä toimittajaa ole suosittu ja kartoituksessa on toimittu tasapuolisesti ja avoimesti. Hankinnan valmistelun yhteydessä toteutettiin markkinakartoitus potentiaalisista toimittajista tutustumalla hankinnan kohteena olevia palveluita tarjoavien toimittajien verkkosivuihin. Kartoituksessa tunnistettiin useita markkinoilla toimivia toimittajia. Hankintayksikkö lähestyi 8 toimittajaa lähettämällä 12.5.2026 tekniseen vuoropuheluun osan tarjouspyyntömateriaalista kommentoitavaksi sekä hankintaan liittyviä kysymyksiä vastattavaksi. Näistä kaksi yritystä vastasi kirjalliseen kommentointiin. Markkinavuoropuhelun tuloksia hyödynnettiin tarjouspyyntömateriaalin viimeistelyssä. Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut kirjallisen selvittelyn perusteella, että hankinnan kohteena oleville palveluille on olemassa toimivat markkinat ja että markkinoilla voi olla useita potentiaalisia toimittajia mutta kirjalliseen vuoropuheluun vastanneiden määrä jäi vähäiseksi. Kartoituksessa saatuja havaintoja hyödynnettiin hankinnan kohteen määrittelyssä, palvelutasovaatimusten arvioinnissa, hinnoittelurakenteen kehittämisessä sekä soveltuvuus- ja referenssivaatimusten tarkentamisessa. Hankinnan valmistelussa on huomioitu hankintalain 65 §:n mukaiset markkinakartoitusta koskevat periaatteet ja hankintayksikkö katsoo valmistelun tukevan kilpailun toteutumista. Hankinnan jakaminen osiin Hankintayksikkö on arvioinut hankinnan jakamista osiin. Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska keräyspaperin, tietoturvamateriaalin ja SER-jätteen poistopalvelut muodostavat toiminnallisesti yhtenäisen palvelukokonaisuuden. Palveluiden tilaaminen, kohdehallinta, raportointi, laskutus ja Sopimuksen seuranta ovat samankaltaisia riippumatta poistettavasta jätejakeesta. Yhden toimittajan malli vähentää hallinnollista työtä, selkeyttää vastuunjakoa sekä tehostaa palvelun koordinointia Tilaajan laajassa ja hajautuneessa kohdeverkostossa. Hankintayksikkö katsoo, että jakamatta jättäminen on hankinnan luonne, toteutustapa ja tarkoituksenmukainen toteutus huomioon ottaen perusteltua.,

Deze rondweg bestaat uit een gemeentelijk deel, de Verlengde Westerdreef en een provinciaal deel, de Laan van Nieuw Land. Bovenstaande objecten dienen ingepast te worden in de omgeving door: • Het aanpassen van de waterhuishouding. • Het realiseren en onderhouden van de Groeninrichting. • Het inpassen van faunavoorzieningen. • Het aanpassen van de onderhoudspaden van Staatsbosbeheer. • Het handhaven van de calamiteitenroute van ProRail en het afschermen van de spoorlijn. • Het inpassen van perceelontsluitingen. • Het afschermen van de weg van de omgeving door het aanbrengen van faunarasters.

title: Finland – Locks, keys and hinges – Lukko- ja oviautomatiikkatarvikkeet ja palvelut OYS
description: Pohjois-Pohjanmaan hyvinvointialue Pohde pyytää tarjoustanne Lukko- ja oviautomatiikkatuotteista ja niihin liittyvistä palveluista. Hankinnan kohteena ovat lukituspalvelut Oulun Yliopistolliseen sairaalaan ja Peltolan kampukselle (Peltolan psykiatrian yksiköt sekä Konsti kehitysvammahuolto). Hankintaa ei ole jaettu osiin, koska OYS:n ja Peltolan yksiköiden lukkopalvelut muodostavat toiminnallisesti, teknisesti ja turvallisuuden näkökulmasta yhtenäisen kokonaisuuden. Kohteiden lukitusjärjestelmät sekä ylläpito ja vikapalvelut edellyttävät keskitettyä kokonaisvastuuta. Hankinnan jakaminen usealle toimittajalle lisäisi rajapintoja, vastuunjakoa ja turvallisuusriskejä sekä vaikeuttaisi häiriötilanteiden hallintaa ja palvelun jatkuvuuden varmistamista. Lisäksi useamman toimittajan käyttö kasvattaisi hankintayksikön hallinnollista työtä ja voisi johtaa päällekkäisiin kustannuksiin. Tämän vuoksi hankinnan toteuttaminen yhtenä kokonaisuutena on palvelun laadun, turvallisuuden, toimintavarmuuden ja kokonaistaloudellisuuden kannalta perusteltua. Sopimuskausi on arviolta 1.2.2027 - 30.9.2028. Hankinnassa on kaksi mahdollista vuoden mittaista optiokautta. Hankinnan ennakoitu maksimiarvo on 1.700.000 € hankintakaudelle optiokaudet mukaan lukien laskettuna. Ennakoitu arvo on arvio perustuen historiatietoon. Uuden sairaalan rakennustyöt ja valmistuminen vaikuttavat tuleviin hankintamääriin. Tilaaja ei sitoudu annettuihin määriin vaan määrät voivat olla pienemmät tai suuremmat. Hankintasopimus ei muodosta Tilaajalle määräostovelvoitetta vaan tarvikkeita ja työtä hankintaan tarpeen mukaan. Hankinnassa valitaan yksi toimittaja. Päätöksen perusteena on suurimman kokonaispistemäärän saanut tarjous, joka täyttää pakottavat vaatimukset.

title: SPS-02357 Temporary Maintenance Staff
description: The SPS has a number of facilities containing buildings and equipment which are required to be inspected, serviced and maintained. This framework shall provide SPS with the capability to employ suitably qualified and experienced temporary staff, covering a range of skill sets required in maintenance services. These staff shall have the relevant disclosure/security clearances (e.g. Level 1 Disclosure Scotland as standard). The supplier shall be able to provide temporary staff to the SPS sites across Scotland and the level of service shall be consistent.

title: BPA - Consumable Supplies for Terumo Trima Accel Blood Collection systems
description: See Soliciation Amendment 0001. USAISR's Combat Casualty Care Research Team 1 (CRT-1) requires resupply of its Blood Donor Room on a reoccurring basis in order to satisfy research requirements for blood collection. USAISR currently has three Terumo Trima Accel Blood Collection Systems in operation. These units support numerous research protocols. title: DeCA Europe Central Distribution Centers Facility Maintenance Call for Solutions
description: HQC0102712In accordance with the Commercial Solutions Opening � Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) OCONUS, posted October 2, 2026 under Notice ID HQCAAA2702 (attached), the following requirement supports Area of Interest (AoI) 5.2 Elevate the Patron Experience. The Defense Commissary Agency (DeCA) is seeking innovative, commercial approaches for long-term service contracts with firms operating in European Union, to provide maintenance and repair of DeCA facilities in Europe. The prospective contractor shall provide a solution to provide these maintenance services that are fully in compliance with EU and host nation specific regulations and standards. The prospective contractor shall provide a Phase I solution for comprehensive preventative, unscheduled, and 24/7/365 emergency maintenance for which includes maintenance for HVAC systems, facilities, and selected equipment for the distribution centers (CDCs) within the Kaiserslautern Military Community (KMC) area which include the Central Distribution Center Germersheim (CDG), Kaiserslautern Cold Storage (KCS) and the Central Meat Processing Center (MPP); the latter two are both located on Ramstein Air Base. Solutions must meet full compliance with applicable host nation (German/EU) statutory requirements and Department of War (DoW) statutory, safety, and warranty standards from firms operating in European Union, compliant with EU and host nation specific regulations and standards as it relates to facility and equipment preventive maintenance and repair. Attached documents contain technical data that will provide assistance in understanding current conditions that the commercial solution will need to meet. Our objective is to establish a long term partnership with a provider whose technology, service model, and commercial terms align with our commitment to delivering reliable, value driven solutions. DeCA seeks solutions that will provide this support for up to five total years, requesting that solutions propose a Period of Performance (PoP) that reflect customary commercial lead times, development lifecycles, and repair benchmarks for the proposed support. The Government reserves the right to adjust the proposed PoP to align with mission requirements, funding availability, and applicable regulatory limitations, including structuring the award as a base period with one or more option periods at the Government's discretion. Interested vendors with proven expertise in providing maintenance services in a commercial warehouse, distribution, and meatpacking centers should submit their written solutions brief (Phase 1) in accordance with section 3.2 Solutions Brief. Pleease see attached Call for Solutions letter for additional information. Attachments are within the PDF document itself, so downloading of the document to be able to access the attachments is required.

description: COMBINED SYNOPSIS/SOLICITATION West Haven Grounds Maintenance VA Connecticut Healthcare System West Haven VAMC Solicitation Number: 36C24127Q0004 Posted Date: October 20th, 2026 Response Deadline: October 29th, 2026, 10:00 AM Eastern Time Set-Aside: Total Small Business Set-Aside NAICS Code: 561730 Landscaping Services Size Standard: $9.5 Million Product Service Code (PSC): S208 Grounds Maintenance Contract Type: Firm-Fixed Price (FFP) Place of Performance: VA Connecticut Healthcare System, 950 Campbell Avenue, West Haven, CT 06516 1. GENERAL INFORMATION This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial services prepared in accordance with the format prescribed in FAR Subpart 12.6, as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation; quotes are being requested and a written solicitation will not be issued separately. This solicitation is issued as a Request for Proposal (RFP). The solicitation document and incorporated provisions and clauses are those in effect through Federal Acquisition Circular (FAC) 2026-01. This acquisition is set aside 100% for Small Business in accordance with FAR 19.502-2. Offerors must be registered and active in SAM.gov at the time of offer submission and at time of award. 2. REQUIREMENT OVERVIEW The Department of Veterans Affairs (VA), Network Contracting Office 1 (NCO 1), on behalf of the VA Connecticut Healthcare System, requires comprehensive grounds maintenance, snow and ice removal, and storm drain maintenance services at the West Haven VA Medical Center. Services are required to support 24/7 Medical Center access and operations for veterans and staff year-round. 3. STATEMENT OF WORK (SOW) 3.1 Background The VA Connecticut Healthcare System requires annual services for grounds maintenance, snow and ice removal, hauling, and treatment services at the West Haven VA Medical Center, located at 950 Campbell Avenue, West Haven, CT 06516. 3.2 Scope of Work The Contractor shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, tools, supervision, disposal, and all incidentals necessary to perform grounds maintenance, snow and ice removal, and storm drain cleaning services as described herein. The Contractor shall coordinate all work with the VA COR and designated representatives of Facilities Management Service. 3.3 Contractor Qualifications To be eligible for award, the Contractor shall: Maintain a field service representative located within 200 miles of the West Haven Campus and capable of responding within two (2) hours. Possess proper equipment, materials, and support to provide all services under this contract. Provide, upon request, documentation of certification and training on specific equipment used under this contract. The CO and/or COR reserve the right to reject any Contractor personnel and refuse permission to work on-site based on credentials or conduct. 3.4 Description of Services 3.4.1 Snow and Ice Removal Snow Removal (SOW §1.1) The Contractor shall remove snow from all sidewalks, steps, stairs, stair and ramp landings, entrance ramps, roadways, roads, parking lots, and parking structures across the West Haven VA campus as delineated in Appendix A (Snow Removal Map) and Appendix D (Lots and Roads). All snow removal zones are considered high priority and shall be worked simultaneously. Snow piling will be in designated locations per the COR. Snow removal shall commence when on-site accumulation reaches one (1) inch and/or within one (1) hour after snowfall stops, whichever occurs first. Snow removal shall continue until all accumulation has ended and all covered surfaces are fully cleared. When snowfall is forecasted, the Contractor shall pretreat all snow removal zones at least two (2) hours prior to each forecasted event. Snow shall not be piled on paved areas (roads or parking lots). Piles shall maintain safety and maximize usable parking area. The Contractor shall clear all handicap access points throughout the campus at all times. Snow removal quantities are based on total snowstorm accumulation as reported by the National Weather Service https://www.weather.gov/ for West Haven, CT. Contract quantities include up to 50 inches of snow and 5,000 lbs of ice melt. Amounts exceeding contract quantities require Contracting Officer authorization via contract modification. Ice melt application shall be included with every snow and ice removal event. All ice and snow melt materials shall be provided by the Contractor. Snow removal shall cover the following areas: Roadways and Drives: Campbell Avenue Entrance, Spring Street Entrance, Lawson Road, Service Road, Building 1 Loading Dock, Building 2 Loading Dock, Building 2 Main Entrance, Building 5 Main Entrance, Ambulance Bay, Ring Road, Building 19, Building 16, and Veterans Drive. Parking Lots (1,378 regular spaces / 129 accessible spaces): Parking Lots 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, 10, 14, 15, 16, 18, 24, Emergency Room, and Fisher House. Sidewalks and Building Entrances (12,636 SF total): All areas as identified in the West Haven VA Medical Center Sidewalk/Walkway and Building Entrance Inventory. Ice Removal (SOW §1.2) The Contractor shall immediately treat and remove ice on all sidewalks, steps, stairs, ramp landings, and entrance ramps. Ice removal shall commence when any accumulation occurs and/or within one (1) hour after ice stops. Approved ice melt product for sidewalks: Calcium Magnesium Acetate (CMA) such as Inferno or equal. Sand is not permitted. Approved product for roads and parking lots: Salt or other COR-approved ice control products. Pretreatment shall occur at least two (2) hours prior to each forecasted ice/freezing precipitation event. The Government will provide a bulk salt storage area on-site for Contractor use. Personnel Management (SOW §1.3) The Contractor shall provide supervision for full utilization of staff and coordination with the VA COR. The Contractor shall provide standard log forms for COR review and approval prior to each option year and submit daily activity logs documenting all campus activities. Response Time and Hours of Operation (SOW §1.5) The Contractor shall provide 24/7 response to snow and ice events within one (1) hour. Parking Garage Snow Removal (SOW §1.6) Prior to each winter season (no later than November 1 of each contract year), the Contractor and COR shall conduct a pre-season walkthrough of the garage. The Contractor shall provide a written photographic damage report within 10 calendar days of the walkthrough. Snow removal from the garage roof deck shall use approved equipment only. Plow trucks shall not exceed 10,000 lbs fully loaded. Plow cutting edges contacting precast surfaces shall have well-maintained rubber tipper blades. Snow piling on the garage deck is not authorized; plows shall be held approximately 1 inch from the deck surface and approach seams at no greater than a 75-degree angle. Parking Garage De-Icing (SOW §1.7) Prior to the first freeze of each season, the Contractor shall submit the de-icing product intended for use, with at least one alternate, and shall walk the garage with the maintenance team to inspect drains and potential problem areas. Authorized products for precast concrete surfaces are limited to Calcium Magnesium Acetate (CMA) or Urea-Based deicers. Equipment weight limits for de-icing match snow removal requirements. Salt and De-Icing Products (SOW §1.8) All products used for snow removal and de-icing must be approved by the COR prior to use. The Contractor is responsible for providing all products required for pretreatment, snow melt, and de-icing. The Government will not provide any snow removal or de-icing products. 3.4.2 Grounds Maintenance Mowing (SOW §2.1) The Contractor shall mow approximately 30 acres of improved grounds at the West Haven VAMC (Appendix C).
